title: Cheat's Sourdough Rolls
description: Quick store-cupboard rolls made from self-raising flour, semi-skimmed milk and mayonnaise. Ready in under half an hour with a rustic, knobbly finish.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Grease and line two baking sheets.
Sift the flour into a bowl and slowly add the milk, stirring constantly. Add the mayonnaise and mix vigorously — the batter should be thick but runny with elastic threads.
Drop heaped dessert spoons of the mixture on to the baking sheets, spaced 4–5cm apart. Neaten the tops.
Bake for 30–35 minutes until risen and just starting to brown. Swap trays halfway through.
Cool on a wire rack before serving.
notes: Makes 12 rolls. Keeps for up to 4 days; can be frozen (use within 1 month).
